name: Mortality improvement scenario
description: A slider from 0 to 30 applies a relative reduction of that many percent to every annual mortality rate, using applyImprovement from the engine. The chart shows baseline and improved together and the statistics show the extra survivors at the current age. Changes apply at once, even mid-play.

userStories.title: Slider and second curve
userStories.description: Add to index.html: . In app.mjs, on input: state.improvement = value / 100, state.improved = survivors(1000000, applyImprovement(table[sex], state.improvement), startAge), update #improvementValue, redraw. Pass two series to drawChart: baseline colour #7fd1ff, improved colour #ffb347. When improvement is 0 pass only the baseline series. Add a small legend element #legend showing the two colours and labels Baseline and Improved, hidden when improvement is 0.
acceptanceCriteria: At 0 only one curve is drawn and the legend is hidden
At 30 the orange curve sits above the blue one at every age between startAge and 120
Moving the slider while playing changes the curve without changing #age

userStories.title: Extra survivors statistic
userStories.description: Add elements #aliveImproved and #extra to the statistics panel. Each render: #aliveImproved shows improved[currentAge - startAge] rounded with toLocaleString('en-GB'); #extra shows the rounded difference improved minus baseline, prefixed with '+', e.g. '+12,345'. Both read '—' when improvement is 0.
acceptanceCriteria: At age 0 #extra shows '+0' when improvement is above 0
At age 85, male, 10%: #extra equals Math.round(improved[85] - baseline[85]) from the engine (check in the console)

technicalNotes.rationale: Wires an existing engine function to a slider and the existing chart.
